metadata.title: Clicked like I’m allergic to aiming and somehow gifted a kill?! Valorant’s broken again
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like aim took a coffee break
Enemy: probably rethinking life choices
That kill wasn’t supposed to happen but hey, I’ll take it!

Tap if your aim ever ghosts you but still kills!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
